product_name_specific: RANGER XP 1000, XP 1000 CREW, Ranger 1000, Ranger 1000 Crew
risk_description: Fuel leaks can occur at the outlet connection of the fuel pump. Leaked fuel can ignite on hot components of the vehicle, creating a fire.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
